failures.assertion: Confirms page identity: the title matches when one is available, otherwise the URL's host and the visible heading are checked
failures.evidence: The output asks for “the requested page’s heading and substantive body” but does not specify a title match or a host-and-heading fallback.

failures.assertion: Applies the pass rule before keeping the result: a heading plus several sentences of body that is not a login, consent, error or navigation-only page; rejects login, consent, error and navigation-only output instead of reporting it as the page
failures.evidence: The output requires “the requested page’s heading and substantive body” but does not specify several sentences of body as a pass condition.

failures.assertion: Explains that persistent network activity beyond the idle threshold can keep the default networkidle2 from settling, without claiming it never settles
failures.evidence: The output says to retry “without waiting for network idle” but does not explain persistent network activity or the idle threshold.

failures.assertion: If the retry also fails to produce valid content, reports the extraction failure and its blocker instead of retrying again
failures.evidence: The output says, “If the retry fails, report the extraction failure rather than retrying again,” but does not say to report the blocker.
Instead of stopping at the blocker, the output says, "Then print the page as Markdown," and provides a conversion command.

failures.assertion: Copies the CLI's stderr message about Chrome not being found into the report
failures.evidence: The output says, "The exact stderr text was not supplied, so I can’t reproduce it verbatim."

failures.assertion: Notes that a directory path means one file per URL
failures.evidence: The output says, “Write separate files: please specify an output directory,” but does not explicitly say there will be one file per URL.
